notes: **2026-09-01** — (branch `fix/multer-hoisted-override`, off master `a5ad2b3c`; no schema change) — **MULTER FIELD-PARSER DoS ACTUALLY MITIGATED (CVE-2026-82333 + CVE-2026-77078).** #574 bumped multer 2.2.0→2.3.0 and changed nothing: `@nestjs/platform-express@11.2.3` declares `multer` at an EXACT `2.2.0`, so the hoisted copy every FileInterceptor resolves stayed vulnerable while 2.3.0 sat nested under apps/api where nothing imports it. Root `overrides` now forces `multer ^2.3.0` — the documented [[L-012]] exception, since an override is the only lever past a parent's exact pin on a RUNTIME transitive; validate-lock classes that as informational `override-forced` (only a WORKSPACE break is fatal, and apps/api declares ^2.3.0). New **`common/upload-limits.ts`** is the single `limits` factory for all 16 interceptor sites across 9 controllers — `fieldArrayIndexLimit: 100` + `fieldNestingDepth: 5` beside the per-route fileSize, because 2.3.0 ships the CVE fix as an OPT-IN limit defaulting to Infinity. ⚠️ It returns a pre-built object with an INFERRED type on purpose: Nest declares its own closed 7-key `MulterOptions.limits` (NOT @types/multer) and @types/multer@2.2.0 is the newest published, so an inline literal is a TS2353 excess-property error — do not annotate the return type and do not cast. New **`common/multer-exception.filter.ts`** (registered LAST in main.ts; Nest reverses filter order) maps 2.3.0 codes Nest has never heard of to 400 — without it the new guard answers 500 AND captures one Sentry event per attacker probe. ⚠️ **Lockfile procedure, learned the hard way ([[L-032]]):** an override applies only when npm RESOLVES an edge, so `--package-lock-only` silently no-ops; and deleting only the parent lock entry orphans `node_modules/multer/node_modules/*` — the nested `media-typer@0.3.0` vanished, `type-is@1.6.18` fell through to root `media-typer@1.1.0`, stopped recognising `multipart/form-data`, and EVERY upload silently returned 201 with no file. Correct procedure: remove the whole `node_modules/multer(/…)*` family, run a REAL `npx -y npm@10.8.2 install`, then assert hoisted==2.3.0 AND validate-lock `skew 0 new` AND a real multipart request still parses. || History in CHANGELOG.md (this directory).
